summary: Before rendering, stamp title on the actual text owner within the nearest explicit header title region; preserve content and bound evidence.
invariants: The nearest explicit data-header-part must be title on the text owner or its ancestor; a nested other header part stops inheritance.
Only the nearest QID owner of actual nonempty text receives title; an empty title wrapper remains decoration.
Canonical stamping is idempotent and precedes rendering so source, pixels and browser metrics retain their correct distinct digest bindings.
An inner no-QID title caption does not promote an outer mixed-body owner.
Text, QIDs, layout, non-target roles, title limits and quality gates remain unchanged.
forbidden: Promoting arbitrary *.title card or pillar subtitles.
Relabeling retained browser evidence without rendering the canonical source.
Treating the HTML render digest as a PNG digest or lowering capacity limits to bypass missing title roles.
